title: pretty NOVA|Plus Size Draped Back Criss-Cross Chiffon A-Line Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Experience elegance with our Plus Size Draped Back Criss-Cross Chiffon A-Line Dress. This stunning dress features a sophisticated draped back with criss-cross detailing, adding a touch of glamour. The A-line silhouette flatters curvy figures, while the lightweight chiffon fabric ensures comfort and grace. Perfect for formal events or special occasions, this dress will make you feel confident and stylish.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Spaghetti straps.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.


Occasion: Formal, Evening party, Wedding guest, Prom, Banquet, Formal occasions, Special event, Bridesmaid
